name: tier2-attachment-and-link
description: Mid-size payload: postguard.encrypted attachment plus a Cryptify /decrypt?uuid= link in the body. The common path. Sized just past the tier-1 boundary — the tier is what this records, and a larger payload only inflates the corpus.
